tooltip.sunlitweed.weed_seed: Grows in spring, summer and autumn. Plant on farmland.
tooltip.sunlitweed.weed_stalk: Dry it in a Dehydrator to keep its quality, or on a drying rack.
tooltip.sunlitweed.dried_weed_stalk: Trim the buds with a knife or cutting board.
tooltip.sunlitweed.weed_bud: Grind in a millstone, crusher or mincer.
tooltip.sunlitweed.ground_weed: Roll with paper, or with a blunt wrap.
tooltip.sunlitweed.blunt_wrap: Made by pressing or cutting dried tubabacco.
tooltip.sunlitweed.joint: Hold right-click to smoke: Regeneration I, a little slow and dizzy. Higher quality lasts longer.
tooltip.sunlitweed.blunt: Hold right-click to smoke: Regeneration II, slow, dizzy and the munchies. Higher quality lasts longer.
tooltip.sunlitweed.golden_teacher: Dry it in a Dehydrator to keep its quality, or on a drying rack.
tooltip.sunlitweed.liberty_cap: Dry it in a Dehydrator to keep its quality, or on a drying rack.
tooltip.sunlitweed.golden_teacher_log: Place within 8 blocks of a Mushroom Log to grow golden teachers.
tooltip.sunlitweed.liberty_cap_log: Place within 8 blocks of a Mushroom Log to grow liberty caps.
tooltip.sunlitweed.dried_golden_teacher: Eat for a long, strong trip, or blend into mushroom tea. Higher quality lasts longer.
tooltip.sunlitweed.dried_liberty_cap: Eat for a short trip, or blend into mushroom tea. Higher quality lasts longer.
tooltip.sunlitweed.mushroom_tea_blend: Brew in a Tea Kettle for 4 cups of mushroom tea.
tooltip.sunlitweed.mushroom_tea: Drink for a long, strong trip.
